sloka: जाम्बवन्तं त्रिभिर्बाणैराजघान स्तनान्तरे।ऋक्षराजं गवाक्षं च जघान बहुभिः शरैः ।। ६.९९.११ ।।
transliteration: jāmbavantaṁ tribhirbāṇairājaghāna stanāntare।ṛkṣarājaṁ gavākṣaṁ ca jaghāna bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.99.11 ।।

translations.english: Mahaparsva pierced three shafts into the chest of Jambavantha and attacked Gavaksha with many arrows.
